verses.text: To your mouth [set] the shofar, as an eagle over the house of YHWH, because they have transgressed My covenant, and against My law they have rebelled.

segments.text: To your mouth [set] the shofar, as an eagle over the house of YHWH, because they have transgressed My covenant, and against My law they have rebelled.

verses.text: To Me they cry, “O My God, Israel, we know You.”

segments.text: To Me they cry, “O My God, Israel, we know You.”

verses.text: Israel has rejected the good; an enemy will pursue him.

segments.text: Israel has rejected the good; an enemy will pursue him.

verses.text: They set up kings, and not from Me; they made princes, and not ones I knew. With their silver and gold they made for themselves idols, that it might be cut off.

segments.text: They set up kings, and not from Me; they made princes, and not ones I knew. With their silver and gold they made for themselves idols, that it might be cut off.

verses.text: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria; My anger burns against them. Until when will they not be capable of innocence?

segments.text: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria; My anger burns against them. Until when will they not be capable of innocence?

verses.text: For it [is] from Israel. A workman made it, and it [is] not God. Surely the calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.

segments.text: For it [is] from Israel. A workman made it, and it [is] not God. Surely the calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.

verses.text: For the wind they sow and they shall reap the whirlwind. The stalk [is] not unto it, a shoot not yielding flour; even if it should produce, strangers would swallow it up!

segments.text: For the wind they sow and they shall reap the whirlwind. The stalk [is] not unto it, a shoot not yielding flour; even if it should produce, strangers would swallow it up!

verses.text: Israel is swallowed up; now they are among the Gentiles, like a vessel with no delight in it.

segments.text: Israel is swallowed up; now they are among the Gentiles, like a vessel with no delight in it.

verses.text: For they have gone up to Assyria; a wild donkey isolated by himself; Ephraim, they have hired lovers.

segments.text: For they have gone up to Assyria; a wild donkey isolated by himself; Ephraim, they have hired lovers.

verses.text: Even though they have hired among the nations, I will now gather them. And they will begin to diminish from the burden of the king of princes.

segments.text: Even though they have hired among the nations, I will now gather them. And they will begin to diminish from the burden of the king of princes.

verses.text: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, they have become unto him altars for sinning.

segments.text: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sin, they have become unto him altars for sinning.

verses.text: Were I to write for him the myriad [things] of My law, they would be regarded as a strange thing.

segments.text: Were I to write for him the myriad [things] of My law, they would be regarded as a strange thing.

verses.text: The sacrifices of My gifts they sacrifice, [and] the flesh they eat—YHWH does not accept them. Now He has in mind their iniquity, and He will attend to their sins: They will return to Egypt.

verses.text: And Israel has forgotten his Maker and has built palaces, and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; and I will send fire upon his cities, and it will devour his palaces.
